svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Serverless web API on AWS subtitle: Single-page app on CloudFront, REST API on API Gateway and Lambda, Cognito sign-in direction: right layout: { spacing: 0.9 } legend: solid: Request path dashed: Sign-in dotted: Authorizer check groups: cloud: { type: aws:cloud } region: { type: aws:region, label: us-east-1, in: cloud } nodes: users: { icon: aws:users, label: Users } # CloudFront is a global service: it sits in the AWS Cloud group, outside the Region. cdn: { icon: aws:cloudfront, label: Amazon CloudFront, in: cloud } site: { icon: aws:simple-storage-service-bucket, label: Web app bucket, note: Static SPA assets, in: region } # align keeps Cognito under API Gateway, the service that calls it. auth: { icon: aws:cognito, label: Amazon Cognito, note: User pool, in: region, align: api } api: { icon: aws:api-gateway, label: Amazon API Gateway, note: REST API, in: region } fn: { icon: aws:lambda-lambda-function, label: Orders function, note: AWS Lambda, in: region } table: { icon: aws:dynamodb-table, label: Orders table, note: Amazon DynamoDB, in: region } uploads: { icon: aws:simple-storage-service-bucket, label: Receipts bucket, in: region } edges: - users -> cdn: HTTPS - users --> auth: sign in - cdn -> site: static files - cdn -> api: /api/* - api ..> auth: Cognito authorizer - api -> fn - fn -> table, uploads

svg.title: Serverless web API on AWS
svg.desc: Serverless web API on AWS. 8 components in 2 groups. Connections: Users to Amazon CloudFront (HTTPS); Users to Amazon Cognito (sign in); Amazon CloudFront to Web app bucket (static files); Amazon CloudFront to Amazon API Gateway (/api/*); Amazon API Gateway to Amazon Cognito (Cognito authorizer); Amazon API Gateway to Orders function; Orders function to Orders table; Orders function to Receipts bucket.

text.tspan: Single-page app on CloudFront, REST API on API Gateway and Lambda, Cognito sign-in
